from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689869/attempts/bb90a5c04b7e45689f74d9e2a14a4f73/system/state/workspace/programs/task-f05bd3b0.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    """Fill hollow rectangular objects: larger cavities with 2, 3x3 centers with 7."""
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in g for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in g))
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = g[r][c]
            if color == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    yy, xx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy,xx) not in seen and g[yy][xx] == color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx))
                        stack.append((yy,xx))
            r0, r1 = min(y for y,x in cells), max(y for y,x in cells)
            c0, c1 = min(x for y,x in cells), max(x for y,x in cells)
            # Only act on complete rectangular borders of the component.
            if r1-r0 < 2 or c1-c0 < 2:
                continue
            border = all(g[r0][x] == color and g[r1][x] == color for x in range(c0,c1+1)) and all(g[y][c0] == color and g[y][c1] == color for y in range(r0,r1+1))
            if not border:
                continue
            fill = 7 if (r1-r0+1 == 3 and c1-c0+1 == 3) else 2
            for y in range(r0+1,r1):
                for x in range(c0+1,c1):
                    if g[y][x] == bg:
                        g[y][x] = fill
    return g
'''

import importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('taskprog',p)
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
def blank(h,w,bg): return [[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
def place(g, rows, c0, pat):
    for i,line in enumerate(pat):
        for j,v in enumerate(line):
            if v!='.': g[rows+i][c0+j]=int(v)
# Demo pair
D=blank(21,17,9)
place(D,0,8,['000','0.0','000'])
place(D,4,2,['666666','6....6','6....6','6....6','6....6','666666'])
place(D,4,11,['444','4.4','444'])
place(D,11,3,['4444','4..4','4..4','4444'])
place(D,13,11,['3333','3..3','3..3','3333'])
place(D,16,0,['333','3.3','333'])
# expected result from described demo
E=[row[:] for row in D]
for r0,r1,c0,c1,col in [(4,9,2,7,2),(11,14,3,6,2),(13,16,11,14,2)]:
    for r in range(r0+1,r1):
        for c in range(c0+1,c1): E[r][c]=col
for r,c in [(1,9),(5,12),(17,1)]: E[r][c]=7
actual=mod.transform(D)
print('demo match',actual==E)
if actual!=E:
 print([(r,c,actual[r][c],E[r][c]) for r in range(21) for c in range(17) if actual[r][c]!=E[r][c]])
